page.overview:
Who is Rosine?

Rosine was a female apostle and a major antagonist in the Conviction Arc.

During her time as a human, she was rather tomboyish and adventurous, spending long hours playing in the woods and enjoying herself and catching small animals.

Jill posits that Rosine's motivation for becoming an elf was identifying herself with and loving the legend of a child named Peekaf who ran away from his village because he looked like an elf and thought he did not know his real parents. When remembering how serious and impressed she looked once Rosine told her she, too, was an elf, Jill notes that Rosine was forcing herself to be cheerful. After becoming an apostle, she refers to herself as "the queen of the elves" and her true form is a giant female luna moth. Dwelling in the Misty Valley, she terrorized nearby villages, in which her elf-like pseudo-apostles ate their livestock and people, as well as capturing children whom she transformed into more "elves" via cocoons.

These actions were done out of a morality which she adopted from the cruelty she went through whilst living in her village. She grew up regularly being beaten, and fun things were always outside the village, a place threatened by hunger, cold and war. Therefore, Rosine believed she was showing kindness to the children. This is shown when she wants to turn Jill into a pseudo-apostle so that no one could hurt her. Rosine shows a possessive streak toward her, repeatedly hugging the girl and claiming she is "hers". She does on the other hand seem to truly care for Jill and love her as a friend, keeping her away from harm. She is also seen flirting with Guts during their combat.
